scope: Shared default styling and small presentation cleanup; no new business features
implementation: Flutter root themes provide ordinary controls, cards, AppBar, menus and typography defaults
Shared button styles remove repeated shape, size, text and state definitions
AppPageTitle, search decoration and code typography replace repeated presentation in actual consumers
AppCard delegates to ordinary Card and inherits its theme
Host-injected HTML defaults cover semantic code, links and separators; aw-ui is optional
JSON formula uses shared prefix input classes; local CSS owns horizontal growth
Removed duplicated history action publication predicate; retained revision, identity, visibility and disposal checks
Added default-style repository rules and documented defaults versus page layout

automated.new_regression: Ordinary widgets without local styles inherit shared typography, heights and surfaces; controls remain interactive

web_preview.scope: Computed browser styles and visual smoke; not native WebKit pixel equivalence

native.scope: Native presentation smoke only; no explicit clipboard-read action or external application action invoked

remaining: Explicit multi-install/Profile selection is not implemented
Obsidian recent files and browser history/bookmarks/tabs remain deferred
Full native application/version/permission/opening matrix and formal release acceptance remain unverified
